newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, bids and offers scarce.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, bids and offers scarce.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract was untraded on Thursday morning, with few bids or offers posted in any period.

Front month June and December were the only two months with both a bid and an offer by the close. Although the range in June was reasonably tight, at 11.25/11.70 pence a therm, in December a full 1.50 pence a therm separated the two, with a 14.25 pence bid facing a 15.75 offer.

Although the contract had a poor week last week with hardly any trade done, this week has so far been busier. The Thursday morning session was only the second time this week when no trade was done. There were only two sessions when trade was done in the whole of last week.
